referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Long Story Short website in Hudson, New York uses bright residential interior with a centered stay enquiry. Navigation is thin wordmark navigation and request-stay control. Its page moves through interior opening, private-stay explanation, gathering proposition, space gallery, experience feature, Hudson guide, guest reactions, stay close, with the space and local experience are presented as two separate planning paths. many real rooms collected in a staggered photo gallery. Transferable mechanics are blush room gallery, red editorial passages, dual space and place routes. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
